title: Natural Light Charters

services.name: fishing charter
services.desc: Fishing with Natural Light Charters? Get the latest Chesapeake Bay fishing conditions: weather, wind, tides and so much more. We offer a full range of services including full day fishing charters, crabbing trips, party and lighthouse cruises and tournament fishing. Book your charter today! The Natural Light is located at the Kentmorr Harbor Marina in Stevensville, Maryland. Join the Natural Light E-Mail List and never miss a thing. Be the first to know about specials, announcements and Chesapeake Bay fishing news. Sign up for our E-Mail List

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Come join us for a Rockfishing Charter on the Chesapeake Bay. It is Rockfishing at it’s best. You’ll have a great time with a fun fishing charter for Rockfish, Flounder, Drum, Bluefish, Trout, Perch or Spot. We also have Crabbing Trips where we will run a trot line and you and your party will get to dip the crabs
